summary_1line: A Brahmana expounds that knowledge, renunciation, and goodness lead to realization of Brahman, using metaphors like the cosmic tree and the two birds of self and intellect.
themes: philosophical debate on duty and reality

image_candidates.scene_text: A vast cosmic tree of Brahman spreads its branches of elements and senses while a sage cuts its trunk with the sword of knowledge.
Two birds sit on the same branch of a great tree, silent companions symbolizing the self and the witnessing intelligence.
A shining drop of water rests on a lotus leaf while a fish swims beneath the surface, illustrating the subtle relation of Purusha and Nature.
